text: Lay a word Sanborn might have used, a number, a unit, a compass point or a theme word, at every place, and see whether a repeating key consistent with the 24 known letters can carry it.
Under a 60-letter key the word's letters that fall on already fixed slots must need the same key letters. DEGREES at place 80 fails at its first fixed slot.
93 words, 376 key lengths and tables that fit the known letters: no word does better than random strings. The test has little power: a word meets few fixed slots, so a miss proves little.
